name: Oprah You Get A Car
aka: You Get a Car, Everybody Gets a Car
look: A TV still of Oprah Winfrey in a bright red suit with gold buttons, arms flung wide and a microphone in one hand, shouting with joy on the set of her talk show.
use: The top text says You get a... and the bottom says Everybody gets a..., showing someone handing something out to everyone with wild enthusiasm, often something nobody wants.
describe: oprah shouting with her arms spread wide
talk show host in red yelling you get one and everybody gets one
excited woman with a microphone giving away prizes
oprah giving away free stuff to the whole audience
woman in a red suit screaming with arms outstretched on stage
origin: From the 2004 episode of The Oprah Winfrey Show in which Oprah gave every audience member a new car.

variants.name: Oprah You Get A Car Everybody Gets A Car
